framework.name: OWASP AI Security Verification Standard (AISVS)
framework.description: Comprehensive engineering and verification requirements across 13 control chapters for AI/ML and Generative AI systems.

controls.title: Training Data Governance and Provenance
controls.description: Verify that training, fine-tuning, and evaluation datasets are inventoried, validated for provenance, and scanned for poisoning or unauthorized sensitive data prior to ingestion.

controls.title: Input Validation and Prompt Boundary Controls
controls.description: Verify that user inputs and external context segments are strictly separated from system instructions using structured roles, spotlighting delimiters, and pre-inference input guardrails.

controls.title: Output Encoding, Sanitization and Sink Protection
controls.description: Verify that all model outputs are treated as untrusted data and undergo context-aware encoding, HTML/Markdown sanitization, Content-Security-Policy enforcement, and parameterized query binding.

controls.title: Data Privacy, PII Scrubbing and Secret Protection
controls.description: Verify that runtime credentials, API keys, and regulated customer PII are excluded from model context and scrubbed via deterministic outbound DLP filters.

controls.title: System Prompt Confidentiality and Secret Exclusion
controls.description: Verify that system prompts contain zero hardcoded credentials or authorization secrets and that output filters prevent verbatim meta-prompt extraction.

controls.title: Model Supply Chain and Artifact Integrity
controls.description: Verify cryptographic signatures, checksums, and provenance of model weights, tokenizers, and container images.

controls.title: Access Control and Multi-Tenant Identity Binding
controls.description: Verify that every AI inference, retrieval, and tool execution request is cryptographically bound to the authenticated caller's tenant and role context.

controls.title: RAG Pipeline, Vector Database and Retrieval Security
controls.description: Verify mandatory server-side tenant ACL pre-filtering on vector similarity searches, bounded chunk sizes (<= 2048 tokens), immutable metadata filters, and pre-ingestion document sanitization.

controls.title: Execution Budgets, Token Ceilings and Agent Loop Control
controls.description: Verify enforcement of explicit max_tokens generation limits, bounded sampling temperature, per-tenant rate limits, and hard agent iteration caps (max_iterations <= 25).

controls.title: Agent Tool Invocation, MCP Security and HITL Gates
controls.description: Verify strict JSON Schema parameter validation ('additionalProperties: false'), server-side scope binding, and mandatory Human-in-the-Loop approval gates for privileged agent tools.

controls.title: Secure AI Infrastructure and Network Egress Isolation
controls.description: Verify that inference runtimes and agent tool runners enforce SSRF egress filtering, private network isolation, and encrypted credential storage.

controls.title: Security Logging, Telemetry and Incident Response
controls.description: Verify structured, secret-redacted logging of guardrail blocks, retrieval metadata, tool invocations, and anomalous token consumption.
